glosses: to refute or disprove an argument sufficiently
To prove (something) to be false or incorrect.

examples.text: After we came out of the church, we stood talking for some time together of Bishop Berkeley's ingenious sophistry to prove the non-existence of matter, and that every thing in the universe is merely ideal. I observed, that though we are satisfied his doctrine is not true, it is impossible to refute it. I never shall forget the alacrity with which Johnson answered, striking his foot with mighty force against a large stone, till he rebounded from it, "I refute it thus."

glosses: To deny the truth or correctness of (something).
Contradecir o impugnar afirmaciones de alguien con razones y argumentos.
